claims.evidence: Witness report only confirms a blue PS4 box (PS4 graphics/markings). No photo confirms the console model is 'slim' or that it is included.

claims.claim: 10 latest games (e.g., FIFA and PES 2027 and others)
claims.evidence: Photos show only the PS4 box and a controller in front; no game discs/cases or screenshots are shown.

risks.risk: Console may not be included (photos show box + controller only).
risks.proof: A clear photo/video showing the actual PS4 console unit powered on (or at least the console being held) along with the controller.
risks.if_unproven: Price as box-only / console not confirmed (worst case: no console).

risks.risk: Console condition unknown (no power-on test; possible faults like no display, overheating, broken ports).
risks.proof: Short power-on video showing the PS4 boot screen and working HDMI output, plus a quick test of controller buttons/joystick.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested / potentially faulty.

risks.risk: Storage capacity (HDD/SSD size) unknown; affects value.
risks.proof: Photo/screenshot of System Settings → Storage (or a visible drive capacity) after boot.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest common capacity scenario.

risks.risk: Accessories completeness unknown (power cable, HDMI, charging cable, headset, manuals).
risks.proof: Lay-out photo of every included accessory with cables clearly visible and counted.

risks.risk: Controller condition unknown (drift, broken buttons, charging issues).
risks.proof: Video showing controller connected and a quick calibration/joystick movement test in-game or in controller settings.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming controller may need repair/replacement.

risks.risk: Box originality/condition and completeness unknown (plastic wrap/scuffing shown; internal packaging not shown).
risks.proof: Photos of box contents inside (manuals/inserts) and any damage to internal packaging.

risks.risk: Region/serial number unknown (warranty/compatibility and authenticity checks).
risks.proof: Photo of the console serial/label (or box label) with region details visible.

proof_requests: Show the actual PS4 console unit (not just the box) and confirm it is included.
Provide a short power-on video with HDMI output working (boot screen visible).
Show controller working: button presses and joystick movement (no drift) in a quick test.
Show System Settings → Storage capacity (HDD/SSD size).
List and photograph all included accessories (power cable, HDMI, controller charging cable, headset/manuals).
Show the game discs/cases (or screenshots) to confirm the claimed '10 latest games' and their condition.
Provide serial number/region label photo for authenticity/compatibility.
response.reason: The witness confirms only a blue PS4 box and a controller, while the seller claims a specific PS4 slim and 10 games—none of which are verifiable from the shown images. Without proof the console and games are actually included and working, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
